ownership_links_style.bus_exception_rule: Use a horizontal bus only when a parent has two or more children.

percentage_label.location: beside child-specific vertical drop, above child box

ownership_links_style.sibling_grouping: For multiple children, draw one horizontal bus per parent with individual vertical drops to each child; all drops attach to the same parent.
ownership_links_style.single_child_alignment_rule: For any one-to-one parent-child relationship, the child node center_x_px must equal the parent node center_x_px. If supplied coordinates differ slightly, snap the child to the parent centerline.
ownership_links_style.single_child_rule: If a parent has exactly one child, do not draw a horizontal bus. Draw one perfectly straight vertical connector from the parent bottom center to the child top center, with no elbow, no jog and no lateral offset.
